title: Staff confirm orders before they are fulfilled
change_type: Change a business rule; add an enum state and an event
seed: Saleor's automaticallyConfirmAllNewOrders channel setting, the orderConfirm mutation and the ORDER_CONFIRMED event; Saleor's AvaTax app commits tax documents on ORDER_CONFIRMED and its SMTP app sends the confirmation email on it
private_fact: The mutation's name and result, the event's name and type, and the rules on which orders are held, when the confirmation email goes out and when the tax document is committed are written only in Core's docs/OPS-7.md

briefs.core:
Change OPS-7: from now on, an order placed in a shop waits for a member of staff to confirm it before it is fulfilled. Core owns the change and decides how it works. When it is done, customers must still be able to buy in the web shop and in every supported build of the mobile app, and renewals must keep flowing.

You own this change. The decision record is in your directory at `docs/OPS-7.md`. Implement it in Core, keep your tests passing (update them to the new behaviour), and make sure every other owner has what they need to do their part.
